newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese businesses expect higher 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese businesses expect higher 1997 profit.

text.p: The majority of Portuguese companies expect to raise profits next year but will not rush to increase investment, according to a poll of businesses published by the weekly Expresso newspaper.

The July poll found that nearly 46 percent of businesses expected to increase profits in 1997 while nearly 36 percent thought results would be little changed from this year and only around 15 percent thought they would post lower profits.
Despite the prospect of higher profits, 47 percent of the 130 businesses polled said they would hold investment steady next year and only 26 percent said they would boost investment.

Only 31 percent of the companies polled, which represent a broad spectrum of the Portuguese economy, expected business to pick up in the final quarter of this year compared with around 36 percent in the June poll.
